
### Compare significance of taxonomic and functional diversities
```{r p_value line}
merged_p <- merge(
  select(functional_adonis[is.na(functional_adonis$p.value) == FALSE, ], variable, fixed, p.value) %>% rename(p_functional = p.value),
  select(taxonomic_adonis[is.na(taxonomic_adonis$p.value) == FALSE, ], variable, fixed, p.value) %>% rename(p_taxonomic = p.value),
  by = c("variable", "fixed")
)

merged_p <- merged_p %>%
  mutate(
    neglog_p_functional = -log10(p_functional),
    neglog_p_taxonomic = -log10(p_taxonomic)
  )

ggplot(merged_p, aes(x = neglog_p_taxonomic, y = neglog_p_functional)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = variable), alpha = 0.7, size = 2, width = 0.1, height = 0.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap("Comparison of p-values between Taxonomic and Functional Diversity", width = 45),
    x = "Taxonomic Diveristy (-log10(p-value))",
    y = "Functional Diversity (-log10(p-value))",
    color = "Metadata Comparison"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("Figures/SubsettedData/TaxonomicFunctionalCorrelation.png", width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```
